char_5.name: Blood Scarred Orc
char_5.flavor: A hardened veteran of a hundred surface raids.

char_6.name: The Shadow Priest
char_6.flavor: Chanter of the dark litanies and keeper of secrets.

DECK_JSON.prompt: An old Orc with <jagged/deep/angry> scars stumbles in. He says he's seen more [[Sun-King]] blood than you've seen gold. Let him stay?
The torches <flicker/dim/turn blue>. A man in hooded robes steps from the shadows of the [[Catacombs]]. He smells of <rot/incense/old earth>.
I caught a surface thief <sneaking/hiding> in the lower vaults. <Flay/Kill/Punish> him?
I remember the layout of the [[Sun-King]]’s armory. Give me 100 men and I’ll bring back <steel/iron/spoils>.

nextCard.cardText: Success. The guards fought <fiercely/hard>, but we have the steel. I'm only missing half my jaw. <Success/Victory/Ouch>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My old wounds <ache/burn/sting>. I need the [[Shadow Priest]]‘s dark magic to keep fighting.
Found some surface <grog/ale/rotgut>. It makes the boyz fight harder… and die <faster/sooner>.
New recruits keep <polishing/cleaning> their armor instead of sharpening axes. Can I <flay/punish/beat> them?
An elf shot me in the kidney with a <glowing/magic> arrow. I kept it as a torch. Can I have a <sick day/rest>?
The recruits don’t know how to properly <sever/cut/lop> a limb! They need live practice.
Back in my day, we rubbed <dirt/mud/sand> in our wounds! Ban these soft healing potions.
I found an orphaned human baby. It looked at me… and <didn’t cry/laughed/spat>.
My axe is rusted, but it holds the blood of a hundred <kings/heroes>. The smith wants to melt it.
My Bruisers want ‘Participation Trophies’ for every <village/town> burned. Flay the sentiment out of them?
Our armor is rusting into our <flesh/skin>. To peel it means <flaying/pain>. To leave it means we are statues.
Recreating my first raid by setting fire to the Swarm’s favorite [[Fungus Farms]]. For the <memories/glory>?
Dark Lords always end as charcoal. Maybe we just… buy better <boots/shoes/gear> instead of statues?
The young ones are using my legendary axe to chop ‘Death-Cap’ fungus. <Flay/Beat> them for the disrespect?
The dark altar requires a sacrifice of <royal/blue> blood to awaken the old ones.
The stars align. We must sacrifice the <plumpest/fattest/juiciest> goblins tonight.
I can bind the <screaming/lost> souls of heroes to our armor. It requires a tithe of gold.
Ethereal whispers from the <abyss/void/deep> are amplifying. Should I answer them?
The Abyss demands a virgin sacrifice, but there is a <blizzard/storm> outside. Use a pure goblin?
I accidentally summoned a lesser demon of <misplaced/lost> items. All the armory keys are gone.

nextCard.cardText: Smashing the doors triggered wards. Vanguard is <singed/burnt/crispy>. <Oops/Bad priest/Mistake>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: [[The Deep Flame]] is hungry, but the pits are closed for a ‘Mandatory Safety Inspection’.
I started a ‘Book Club’ reading the Necronomicon. The goblins are <learning/reading/literate>.
Tentacles are erupting from the <plumbing/drains/sewers>. The plumbers want hazard pay.
The dark gods demand a ‘[[Soul-Taxes|Void Tax]].’ 20% of shiny rocks must be <tossed/thrown> in.
My resonant chanting is causing <stalactites/rocks> to fall. Should I hum instead?
[[The Deep Flame]] is flickering. Toss in the ‘Employee of the Month’ to brighten the mood?
I suggest we replace torches with ‘[[Grave-Wax]] Candles.’ They smell of <rot/death/ancient times>.
I have curated a ‘Gallery of Agony’. It is merely Goblins attempting <math/logic>. A masterpiece!
I am bored. The Abyss demands a sacrifice, or a lecture on the <philosophy/meaning> of nothingness.
Merchant is selling ‘Sacrificial Indulgences’. For gold, a goblin is <exempt/safe> from rituals!
Abyss is pouting. Cheering it up requires <elite Bruisers/warriors> or the gold vault.
